theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.natDegree_ge_quadratic {Cn c num : Polynomial ℤ} (hu : IsUnit num) (n m : ℕ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : Cn * qPochC Polynomial.X n ^ 2 * qPochC Polynomial.X m ^ 3 = c * num) :
2 * (n * (n + 1)) + 3 * (m * (m + 1)) ≤ 2 * c.natDegree

theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.natDegree_qPochC (n : ℕ) :
2 * (qPochC Polynomial.X n).natDegree = n * (n + 1)

qPochC Polynomial.X n ≠ 0

theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.qPochC_succ_eq (n : ℕ) :

1 - Polynomial.X ^ (k + 1) ≠ 0

theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.natDegree_one_sub_X_pow_succ (k : ℕ) :
(1 - Polynomial.X ^ (k + 1)).natDegree = k + 1

theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.natDegree_unbounded_of_all_levels {C c num : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ} {mm : ℕ → ℕ} (hu : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsUnit (num n)) (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ), c n ≠ 0) (h : ∀ (n : ℕ), C n * qPochC Polynomial.X n ^ 2 * qPochC Polynomial.X (mm n) ^ 3 = c n * num n) (D : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.level_le_of_natDegree_le {Cn c num : Polynomial ℤ} (hu : IsUnit num) (n m D : ℕ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : Cn * qPochC Polynomial.X n ^ 2 * qPochC Polynomial.X m ^ 3 = c * num) (hD : c.natDegree ≤ D) :

theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.natDegree_ge_of_bridge_combined {Cn c num : Polynomial ℤ} (hu : IsUnit num) (n m : ℕ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : Cn * qPochC Polynomial.X n ^ 2 * qPochC Polynomial.X m ^ 3 = c * num) :

theorem QOU.QBeta.LevelMixing.natDegree_ge_of_bridge {mas c num : Polynomial ℤ} (hu : IsUnit num) (m : ℕ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : mas * qPochC Polynomial.X m ^ 3 = c * num) :
